channel.title: La Paix du Cœur — News
channel.description: The latest from La Paix du Cœur: campaigns, street outreach, food drives and workshops in Montréal.

item.title: A new website, in French and English
item.description: Secure online giving, a calendar, captioned videos, shareable cards: here’s what’s new.

item.title: Christmas 2026: the campaign is live
item.description: Baskets, coats, school supplies: our first online Christmas campaign aims to raise $25,000 by December 25 — and every gift is doubled until the 15th.

item.title: One outreach night in October
item.description: Hot soup, wool socks and long conversations: an evening on the downtown streets.

item.title: Workshop: building a budget, gaining independence
item.description: One Saturday morning, twelve participants learned to build a simple family budget. The next session is in January.
